output.title: Spacious 3-Bedroom Duplex with Terrace and City Views in Cloche d'Or
output.description:
This newly built duplex apartment offers 180 m² of well-planned living space across two levels in the Cloche d'Or district. The expansive living room features a double-height ceiling and panoramic glazing, accentuating the volume and natural light while providing views of the adjacent new park. Engineered oak flooring enhances the modern aesthetic throughout.

The open-plan kitchen is equipped with fully integrated Siemens appliances and a quartz worktop, seamlessly connecting to the dining and living areas for a sociable atmosphere. Soft-close cabinetry adds to the sleek, contemporary design.

The upper level houses three bedrooms, including a master bedroom with fitted wardrobes and direct access to a wraparound terrace finished with wood decking. This outdoor space offers views over the nearby shopping center and benefits from evening sun exposure.

Additional conveniences include an elevator serving the building, a dedicated parking space, and a separate cellar room for storage. Located in Cloche d'Or, a district known for its modern office developments, shopping facilities, and parks, the setting reflects a contemporary urban environment with diverse amenities.
